The '''siege''' of Kaleth happened during [[Rajivari's purges]] after the fallen [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Rajivari]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in his attempt to murder his fellow Masters and reshape the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] which he had co-founded, and his followers barricaded in Rajivari's fortress of [[Kaleth]], where they put up a last stand fight against the Order. All of Rajivari's followers were killed as a result and the conflict was officially ended.<ref name="TOR" />
